title: Wegner’s planar graph-square conjecture
statement: Wegner’s planar graph-square conjecture · 1977. Its Δ=4 case predicts that the square of every planar graph is 9-colorable.

counterexample.description: A connected maximum-degree-four graph with a spherical rotation system whose square is not 9-colorable. Confirming this requires checking the embedding and exhausting the coloring search.
